video_title: LeBron, Embiid or Maxey: Who Should Take Philly’s Last Shot?

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Philadelphia 76ers lack a singular go-to option in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: That's the beauty and that's the problem. You have four guys that can go get a bucket.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: Do you need a singular go-to option that you know?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Absolutely not. That's the beauty and that's the problem. You have four guys that can go get a bucket. You have Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, and then you have guys like Kawhi Leonard, Stephen Curry, and Kevin Durant. There is no wrong answer.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: You have to place that. You have Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, and Kevin Durant. There is no wrong answer.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Philadelphia 76ers' offensive strategy creates confusion for opposing defenses
quotes.excerpt: It's a flow to create confusion and best shot possible.
quotes.quote: It's a flow to create confusion and best shot possible. You can run a slip screen with Joel Embiid rolling, LeBron James as the initiator, or you can run Tyrese Maxey, LeBron James sets a screen. If Tyrese Maxey comes off, they double, you throw it to LeBron James. Now LeBron James has to make the decision, which is a good place to be. It's more of you get to put the reason why you couldn't beat the Slash Brothers with Joel Embiid and Tyrese Maxey. We figured out a defense towards the end. When you added Kevin Durant, there was no defense that you could come up with that could stop all three of them.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey's versatility as a transition and half-court playmaker
quotes.excerpt: I think it's awesome that Tyrese Maxey is such a north and south player.
quotes.quote: I think it's awesome that Tyrese Maxey is such a north and south player. Because if you have Jaylen Brown, LeBron James, and Joel Embiid, who are all elite in transition, when he gets downhill, even at the end of a game, if you leave him, you are either giving him a layup and you are contesting late, or it's a drop-off pass to Joel Embiid, who is one of the best scorers in the NBA. Or it's a kick-out to guys who have been point guards in their own right. So for me, I love that they are working through Tyrese Maxey because he is giving them such easy shots.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson explains the tactical advantage of his playing style
quotes.excerpt: My game was predicated on angles, someone closing out to me.
quotes.quote: I had no wiggle to my game. You put me in a one-on-one situation, there wasn't a lot of wiggle. My game was predicated on angles, someone closing out to me. And thinking about it, Jaylen Brown is going to have people closing out. You are at an advantage. I can pump fake, I can go against the grain right back at you. There are so many things versus me staring at five players trying to stop me. How much easier is it in the last 10 seconds if I got a player closing out to me? Now I got a foul opportunity, now the weak side defense could be late, could not be late, or they have to stay home.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of LeBron James' mentorship on young players' confidence
quotes.excerpt: He came in off the bench and received two quick dimes from LeBron James.
quotes.quote: He came in off the bench and received two quick dimes from LeBron James. Do you know what that does for his confidence? Real quick layup. The thing that I say is that they don't have a go-to guy, but they do have a pecking order from what I see. And a pecking order is Tyrese Maxey first, Jaylen Brown second, Joel Embiid third, then LeBron James is like, I'm on the back burner, whatever y'all need me to do. That wasn't established in training camp. That shit was established when LeBron James signed in Philly and then all of a sudden the videos start circulating on social media that those guys were working out together.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey's leadership and alpha status within the team
quotes.excerpt: The way Tyrese Maxey has walked into this year, he walked in as an alpha.
quotes.quote: The way Tyrese Maxey has walked into this year, he walked in as an alpha, and everybody has respected that. So he walked in with a whole, he walks in every day of, this is my shit, I'm the leader and everybody is like, yes, we're following.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse's track record of developing elite guards
quotes.excerpt: Nick Nurse is a guards coach. Every guard Nick Nurse has ever coached has either won a chip.
quotes.quote: Nick Nurse is a guards coach. Every guard Nick Nurse has ever coached has either won a chip, got there, or got paid.
